How Steve Fox connects

  • Faction: G Corporation — Steve Fox's past is a genetic program tied to Mishima and G Corporation labs.

What is Steve Fox?

Steve Fox is the British boxer who learned his past was a Mishima / G Corporation genetic program, tying an otherwise clean sports story to the Devil Gene war.

Key threads lead to G Corporation.
